method: Independently read all 70 retained bodies, all attached context, every unused block, and all 28 taxonomy nodes. No earlier report judgments copied.
Compared source-block concatenation with original run input text and exact resumed-bank first-four source/question objects.
Visually inspected original PDF HTK pages 6–7, TBH page 1, TQC pages 1–2, QT pages 1–2 to resolve interleaving, radical scopes and diagram dependency.
Complete retained printed exercises are ambiguous rather than false omissions when gold merely prefers independent subpart splitting. Broad relevant mixed-topic ancestors accepted.
All indices are 0-based source block ids; input lines are 1-based. One text block equals one input line. Unused is computed complement, not an assertion about undocumented model ignore metadata.

summary.release_claim: Not a clean pass: 6 retained questions have contextual contamination/task-mode defects; 3 complete groups have nonpreferred granularity. No organizational misclassification found in this snapshot.

principal_findings.detail: Whole text blocks reused to recover diagram labels also import previous option/next stem; PDF confirms original figure-label origin. Missing figure is upstream, unrelated text attachment is candidate-level.

Required choose true/false instruction is in unused blocks 179–180; all four assertions remain together, but task-mode instruction is absent. This is available-input context loss, not PDF extraction loss.
Four-unit total deficit versus 74 preferred count is caused by complete grouped tasks; no missing printed question.

PDF reveals √11/√14 legs, y², and √5/√3 options that text input flattened. Do not claim numerical completeness from apparently plain numbers. Gold prose also abbreviates TBH legs 11/14; PDF disambiguates without editing frozen gold.
